title: SDD apply — cli
content:
Envy CLI is implemented on `darkfactory/cli/maker` and committed as `4977544`. All 15 acceptance scenarios are covered; `go test ./...` passes.

### Commands
`list` · `check` (`--ci`) · `doctor` · `diff` · `run` · `get`/`set`/`delete` · `import`/`export` (`--reveal`) · `agent grant`/`revoke`

Secrets stay redacted by default. Agent writes use `--as-agent` and require an active grant. Mutations (ok/denied) append to `.envy/audit.jsonl` without plaintext secrets.

### Code review

## Standards
- Hard: in-place envfile mutation (existing pattern); a few functions >50 lines; TUI `model.go` ~800 lines (starter baggage).
- Judgement: `--as-agent` parsing was duplicated → extracted `parseAsAgentFlag`.

## Spec
- All 15 scenarios have working paths + acceptance tests.
- Remaining notes: doctor gitignore is **warn** (not fail) when `.git` is absent; grant `read_values` denial is grant metadata (human `--reveal` still works by design).

**Summary:** Standards ~5 (mostly pre-existing size/mutation); Spec ~2 partials (gitignore-without-git, read_values as grant default). Worst Standards: large TUI file in CLI tree. Worst Spec: none blocking after durable audit + agent revoke gating.
